instruction: Reset friends on venmo to be the same as my friends in my phone. Befriend and unfriend as needed.
notes: Two apps plus supervisor. The agent must (1) read passwords, (2) log into phone and list contacts filtered by relationship="friend", (3) log into venmo and list current friends, then (4) add every phone friend missing on venmo and remove every venmo friend not in the phone friend list. Private data (actual people) is unknown, so placeholder persons are used: contact-friend-1/2 (phone friends to befriend), venmo-only-friend-1 (venmo friend to unfriend) and mutual-friend-1 (already consistent, must stay a friend). Persons are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can literally state the per-person goal literals (the convention forbids quantified goals/conditional effects). Static world facts (phone-friend, venmo-friend, email-of, username-for, password-for) live in :init; what the agent learns is modeled by the nullary knowledge gates phone-friends-known / venmo-friends-known (same pattern as passwords-known + password-for), which both add_friend and remove_friend require, forcing both lookups before any change. The goal demands the final venmo friend set equals the phone friend set (added = phone-only, removed = venmo-only, mutual untouched), matching the evaluation of venmo.Friendship changes. Pagination of search_contacts/search_friends is abstracted into a single call each. The reference plan has 9 calls: passwords, phone login, search_contacts, venmo login, search_friends, 2x add_friend, 1x remove_friend, complete_task (no answer).
